newsitem.title: CANADA: N. American ag ministers to address trade issues.
newsitem.headline: N. American ag ministers to address trade issues.

text.p: State and provincial agriculture ministers from Mexico, the United States and Canada plan to meet in Alberta Thursday and Friday to discuss trade issues, an Alberta government statement said.
"The initial purpose of the accord...was to talk about trade irritants before they disintegrated into full-blown formal disputes," said Barry Mehr, assistant deputy minister for Alberta Agriculture.
Agricultural trade issues up for negotiation at the next round of World Trade Organization negotiations in 1999 and the idea of a free trade area for the Americas are on the agenda.
The ministers plan to meet in Canmore, Alberta.
